nodes.label: SLO Catalog
nodes.rationale: Eight capability SLOs (local durability 99.99%, cloud ingest 99.95%, relay latency, action resolution 99.9%, stream replay 99.99%, verification 99%, repair workflow 99%, API availability 99.95%) measured from server/worker metrics plus synthetic probes, never client-only analytics; explicit overload rejections are reported separately from availability.

nodes.label: Burn-Rate Alerting Policy
nodes.rationale: Multi-window burn rates (5-minute 14.4x with 1-hour 6x pages immediately; 30-minute 6x with 6-hour 3x pages during coverage); alerts carry correlation IDs, digest, runbook, and dashboard but never prompts, source, credentials, or payment data.

nodes.label: Correlation IDs and Bounded Sampling
nodes.rationale: Request/event/session/action/workflow IDs propagate on traces and logs for investigation but are never metric labels; errors are sampled at 100% while SLI counters remain unsampled, and local telemetry is opt-in and disabled by default.
